column1: # component-registry.tsv — canonical registry of load-bearing components/planes/subsystems/entrypoints.
# Consumed by fleet/checks/registry-discovery.sh (DISCOVER leg). Every row declares a component that
# the fleet treats as load-bearing: it MUST have a canary/detector OR an explicit exemption. The
# discovery gate FAILS CLOSED on any component in graphify's code graph that is absent from this file.
# CONFORMANCE: every row must be parseable (tab-separated, exactly 8 fields). A malformed row is RED.
# DRIFT: a row whose canary file does not exist, or whose test file does not exist, is STALE -> RED.
#   kind          - plane | subsystem | entrypoint | tool | gate | detector
#   path          - repo-relative path or ref (or "." if N/A)
#   canary        - path to the canary/detector script (relative to fleet/; or "." if exempted)
#   test          - path to the dogfood test script (relative to fleet/tests/; or "." if exempted)
#   owner         - owning ticket id (or "infra" for infrastructure components)
# ADDING A NEW COMPONENT: add a row here, wire a canary + test. If a canary cannot exist yet, set
# status=exempted with a note explaining why and a target ticket.
# NO SILENT DELETION: removing a row without migrating its canary+test to a replacement is drift.
# The discovery gate REDs. See docs/review-log/KS29-DISCOVERY-LEG.md.
